title: $10 million for Neighbourhood Houses
summary: The Nationals pledge $10 million over four years for Victoria's Neighbourhood Houses: $4 million to keep existing houses financially sustainable and $6 million in a fund to open and grow houses in fast-growing areas that currently miss out on state funding.
costing: $10 million over four years ($4 million sustainability funding, $6 million new fund) — party figure
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: Provide $4 million to keep existing Neighbourhood Houses financially sustainable.

title: Review the entire tax system and repeal the Short Stay Levy
summary: The Nationals pledge to review the entire tax system after reforming land tax, payroll tax, stamp duty and taxes on GP visits. They specifically commit to repealing the Short Stay Levy.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: We will also review the entire tax system to make it simpler, fairer and better for growth.

title: Free meningococcal B vaccines for children and teenagers
summary: The Nationals pledge free meningococcal B vaccination for children and teenagers, removing the cost for parents.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: The Nationals will ensure free meningococcal B vaccinations for children and teenagers to protect against a serious and potentially life-threatening disease.

title: $52 million for Aboriginal urgent care pathways
summary: The Nationals pledge $52 million to expand Urgent Care Pathways through Aboriginal Community Controlled Organisations, giving more Aboriginal Victorians access to healthcare closer to home.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: The Nationals in Government will invest $52 million to expand the Urgent Care Pathways initiative, giving more Aboriginal Victorians access to vital healthcare closer to home.

title: 60-day gas exploration request for proposal process
summary: Within 60 days of forming government, the Nationals pledge a statewide Request for Proposal inviting gas producers to identify conventional gas opportunities and how quickly they could bring them into production. Proposals would be assessed under existing laws, with approvals streamlined and an Energy and Resources Cabinet sub-committee established.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: Within 60 days of forming government, we will launch a statewide Request for Proposal process, inviting gas producers to identify Victoria’s best conventional gas opportunities and how quickly they can responsibly bring them into production.

title: Remove the Wonthaggi Overlay
summary: The Nationals pledge to remove the Wonthaggi Overlay from affected homes, ending requirements for property-level environmental assessments that the party says have cost residents thousands of dollars.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: The Nationals will rip up Labor’s Wonthaggi Overlay and remove it from affected homes in Wonthaggi.

title: Forest Management Program and local native timber processing
summary: The Nationals pledge a Forest Management Program aimed at protecting healthy forests and restoring degraded ones, with public land management focused on forest health. They also pledge to process native timber at Victorian sawmills and double planned burns to reduce fuel loads.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: The Nationals in Government will protect healthy forests and restore degraded ones through a Forest Management Program that puts healthy, resilient forests at the centre of public land management.

title: Introduce Jack's Law weapon-scanning technology
summary: The Nationals pledge Jack's Law, allowing Victoria Police to scan and detect weapons and remove them before they can be used in criminal activity.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: The Nationals will introduce Jack’s Law allowing Victoria Police to scan and detect weapons and remove them before they can be used in criminal activity.

title: Mandatory training for Working with Children Checks
summary: The Nationals pledge mandatory training as part of the Working with Children Check system, covering legal responsibilities, identifying risky behaviour and appropriate reporting.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: The Nationals will introduce mandatory training as part of the Working with Children Check system to strengthen child safety across Victoria.

title: Publish Children's Court sentencing data in SACStat
summary: The Nationals pledge to expand the Sentencing Advisory Council's SACStat database to include Children's Court sentencing data for the first time, along with more detailed anonymised sentencing information.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: The Nationals will expand the Sentencing Advisory Council’s SACStat database to include Children’s Court sentencing data for the first time, along with more comprehensive anonymised information on sentencing outcomes, ranges and trends.

title: Require major protests to be registered with police
summary: The Nationals pledge to require major protests to be registered with Victoria Police so authorities can plan for disruption. The party says the right to protest would be retained.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: The Nationals will require major protests to be registered with Victoria Police to better manage disruption and protect community safety.

title: Tobacco licensing scheme and illegal trade crackdown
summary: The Nationals pledge stronger enforcement and a licensing scheme targeting illegal tobacco shops, which they link to firebombings and organised crime.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: Stronger enforcement and a tough licensing scheme will crack down on illegal tobacco, shutting down the illegal black-market shops fueling firebombings and organised crime gangs.

title: Tougher graffiti penalties and faster clean-ups
summary: The Nationals pledge tougher penalties for graffiti offenders and faster removal of graffiti from roadsides, alleys, town centres and transport hubs.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: The Nationals will clean up our roadways, alleys and communities by introducing tougher graffiti penalties and faster clean-ups.

title: Establish a Victorian Productivity Commission
summary: The Nationals pledge an independent Productivity Commission to monitor government spending and regulation. It would produce an Intergenerational Report updated every five years.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: An independent Productivity Commission will be established to monitor government spending and regulation, making sure taxpayers get the best value for money.

title: Transfer Melbourne wholesale market to industry
summary: The Nationals pledge to transfer ownership of the Melbourne Wholesale Fruit and Vegetable Market at Epping to industry and give wholesalers, growers and tenants a stake. ABC News reports the move is expected to raise $578 million.
costing: $578 million expected to be raised (as reported by ABC News)
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: The Nationals in Government will transfer ownership of the Melbourne Wholesale Fruit and Vegetable Market at Epping to industry, giving wholesalers, growers and tenants the opportunity to own a stake in its future.

title: Ombudsman investigation into domestic building insurance
summary: The Nationals pledge an Ombudsman investigation into domestic building insurance following builder collapses.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: The Ombudsman will be called in to investigate domestic building insurance so families left high and dry by builder collapses finally get answers and a fairer system.

title: Successful School Starters with $500 specialist subsidy
summary: The Nationals pledge to embed occupational therapists and speech pathologists in every Victorian prep classroom from Term 1, 2028 to assess and refer neurodiverse students, with a $500 subsidy towards an initial specialist appointment. They describe it as a first-of-its-kind program in Australia.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: Successful School Starters will commence in every Victorian prep classroom from Term 1, 2028, with occupational therapists and speech pathologists embedded within the existing Primary School Nursing Program.

title: $1.5 million for a Melbourne Royal Show master plan
summary: The Nationals pledge $1.5 million towards a new master plan for the Melbourne Showgrounds and say they will work with Melbourne Royal on the show's future.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: The Nationals in Government will work with Melbourne Royal to support the future of the Melbourne Royal Show, including a $1.5 million investment towards a new master plan for the Showgrounds.

title: Duplicate Dyson Drive in Ballarat
summary: The Nationals pledge to duplicate Dyson Drive between Remembrance Drive and the Ballarat-Carngham Road to improve traffic flow in Ballarat's growing suburbs.
sourceTitle: Nationals Policies for Regional Victoria | 2026 Election
excerpt: The Nationals in Government will duplicate Dyson Drive between Remembrance Drive and Ballarat-Carngham Road, getting Ballarat’s growing suburbs moving.
